chapters.title: Chapter 1 — The Unlocked Door
chapters.summary: Someone let themselves into the Mercer house with the family's spare key, then smashed the window from the inside to stage a break-in. Mom is gone. And a feather that holds light was left behind, as if something not quite human had been there too.
chapters.teaser: Next: the neighborhood. Someone on this street saw something tonight.
